set.body: Consumer ephys4s-provider-ravel-bulk-primitive at canonical 9b53145ebb5a9547fe003b5117e05da9d6eff186. Generic fromSeq copy of 65536 Double cells allocates 526760 bytes warmed by default, but 2100280 with JVM escape analysis disabled, versus payload 524288. Need primitive owned Float/Double array copy and allFinite on readable layouts without Boolean materialization or per-cell boxing. Acceptance: owned copy shape/alias/IEEE semantics; empty scalar offset permuted reversed strided broadcast and mutable/borrowed finite scans; JVM/JS regressions; bounded allocation with/without escape analysis; explicit consumer qualification before canonical admission. Candidate branch feat/primitive-copy-finite; evidence docs/verification/remaining-2026-10-13/ravel in ephys4s.
set.title: Add owned primitive copies and bounded finite reduction
